steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect circuit breaker or power cable before servicing electrical parts. Reconnect panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the circuit breaker or power cable before servicing.

steps.title: Door closure
steps.body: Verify door latched completely, racks not interfering, unit level.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify door latched completely, racks not interfering, unit level.

steps.title: White wire door voltage correct?
steps.body: Measure white wire switch: Normal 10.5–13 V when door open; <1 V when door closed.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure white wire switch: Normal 10.5–13 V when door open; <1 V when door closed.

steps.title: Blue wire door switch continuity?
steps.body: Power off, connector removed: SHORT when door open; OPEN when door closed.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off, connector removed: SHORT when door open; OPEN when door closed.

steps.title: Replace door switch
steps.body: Replace door sensing switch when continuity or voltage fails.
steps.oemOutcome: Replace door sensing switch when continuity or voltage fails.

steps.title: Door switch OK
steps.body: Door circuit verified — if cycle still won't start, check power relay and main PBA.
steps.oemOutcome: Door circuit verified — if cycle still won't start, check power relay and main PBA.
